title: Oura Sleep Score vs Next-Day Stress
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:stress
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(sleep_score) as avg_sleep_score avg(stress_score) as avg_stress_score by _time weekday
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sleep score and next-day stress over time and breaks it out by weekday.
value: Putting sleep score beside next-day stress helps confirm whether recovery habits are actually paying off.
implementation: Send sleep score and next-day stress events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sleep score and next-day stress by weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how sleep score and next-day stress changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
